EC1: history of major systemic illness, including uncontrolled hypertension [OR], diabetes [OR], chronic renal insufficiency, [OR] autoimmune diseases [OR] or malignancies
EC2: history of neurological disorders [AND] which might affect sensation such as previous stroke [OR] or peripheral neuropathy
EC3: history of substance abuse ([NOT] except painkillers)
EC4: heavy smokers (with a daily consumption >20 cigarettes)
EC6: any contraindication [AND] for magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
EC7: and any obvious infection [OR] or inflammation over a period of at least 1 month before the study.
